diagnosis: Indolent T-cell lymphoma of the gastrointestinal tract, CD4 immunophenotype
legend: The duodenal biopsy shows villus atrophy, crypt hyperplasia, and expansion of the lamina propria by an infiltrate of small lymphocytes. Intraepithelial lymphocytes are not increased (<<31637>>). The lamina propria has a dense infiltrate of small lymphocytes exhibiting mature morphology. Focal infiltration of the crypt epithelium is present (<<31638>>). The lymphocytes are CD4-positive (<<31639>>).
